response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS advanced_behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr >= 0.149;

assumptions.assumption: "At least 0.149" means peercorr >= 0.149, inclusive of 0.149 itself. Records with a NULL peercorr are not counted, since NULL never satisfies a comparison.
"Advanced behaviour records" means rows in the advancedbehavior table, one per abhvreg, so the count is of rows rather than distinct translink values.
